referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of components for an average heat production system for a building with a specific heat demand of 30 W per m2 heated gross floor area; UUID: 057cbf65-064e-3b78-a772-2333560db627
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Materials used for the production. Transport of raw materials to the plant. Energy use for the production and processing of the raw materials. No infrastructure of the production site included.
referenceFunction.localName: Heat production system, specific heat demand 30W
referenceFunction.name: Heat production system, specific heat demand 30W

geography.text: Data sources mainly from Switzerland. Process applicable in central European conditions.

technology.text: Average of different heat production technologies; including furnaces for gas, oil, wood pellets and wood logs; no system with heat pump in average included

timePeriod.text: Amount of material for average investigated in 2008. Process information partly from 1994 to 2003

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Manufacturer informations and literature data. Data of typical product range for small and medium buildings used (10-100kW).
